node.statement: Conclusion. Apply lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement to the explicit datum of node 1.5: for m>1 its literal sum map is an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion C^{m+1}->A, while for m=1 the old side is absent and the conclusion is the supplied fresh inclusion, exactly as that external states. Record D_1*t_1 (respectively the supplied fresh defect in the exceptional branch) as the raw defect of the literal output. Nodes 1.1-1.5 show that K_1,e_call_1 are universal, K_1*e_call_1<=e_1, all three producer and old-compression thresholds are absorbed, and the required explicit raw-call datum exists for every displayed A,w,j with t_1=K_1*epsilon; this is the root contract.
